svg.title: Three reads through one URI template, failing at two different stages
svg.desc: Four stages run left to right: the request as sent, the matcher, the gate, and the outcome. The gate is drawn as two upright posts and labelled your allowlist. Three lanes cross them. The first, for disk root, is ticked at the matcher where the variable binds and ticked again at the gate, and reaches a handler that returns five lines of plain text. The second, for disk etc, is ticked at the matcher but crossed at the gate as not on the list, and a dashed line carries error minus 32602 with the message Unknown disk quote etc quote, Known disks colon root, raised by your allowlist. The third, a path-traversal string, is crossed at the matcher itself with the note no match at all, the gate is marked never reached, and the outcome is the SDK saying Unknown resource with a note that the handler was never entered. A band at the bottom explains that the third lane stops early only because a simple brace disk brace expansion does not match a value containing a slash, which is the shape of the template rather than a check anyone wrote, and that the gate is the only stage under your control.
svg.text: One template, three URIs, two different places to fail
Template: system://disk/{disk}. Allowlist: one entry, named root.
Lane 3 stops early because a simple {disk} expansion does not match a value containing a slash.
That is the shape of the template, not a check you wrote. Stage 2, the allowlist, is the only part you control.
